what: Receiver-written manifests on tau2-bench (MIT) public leaderboard trajectories: 120 runs (60 false successes, 60 correct), 67 tasks. Manifests written by three LLMs from the customer request, the policy and the pre-work records. 'base' = as written; 'filtered' = checks with bad syntax dropped and checks that failed on any known-correct earlier run of the same task dropped (105/120 runs had such runs). Counts are [false successes rejected, false successes, correct runs rejected, correct runs]. Methods and the sample were pre-registered before the manifests were written.
